messages.text:
BL-1000 — Both freshness shell tests bind their conf seam to the LIVE operator-tunable daemon_log_freshness.conf, then stage a 200s-stale heartbeat and assert a restart - so any ops raise of handoffd's 120s threshold reddens the suite for a reason unrelated to the code; the pinned fixture that fixes it already exists on disk, untracked in every worktree, wired to nothing
What it solves: The orphan fixture is evidence, not a deliverable handed over: the
specifier did not create it, has not moved or deleted it, and it remains
untracked in every working tree. Whoever adopts it should confirm its
contents still match the live conf's rows before pinning them - today they
agree on both …
Approval context: What needs sign-off: nothing about the diagnosis - it is settled by inspection (see source). The one judgement call is the SCOPE. This ticket fixes the two files that demonstrably carry the coupling and tracks the fixture, and deliberately does NOT sweep the whole shell suite for other tes…
BL-1000 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1000" (or "reject BL-1000 <reason>") to act.
